title: Functions
explain: Functions list parameter types after the names and the return type after the parentheses. A function can return several values, which Go uses for results and errors. Functions are also values, so you can store them in variables and pass them around.
exercise: Write `minMax(nums []int) (int, int)` that returns the smallest and largest values in a slice.
tip: Ignoring the `error` return value is the most common beginner bug. Check `err != nil` right after the call.
